## Services

### Water Damage Restoration

- **Page**: [Water Damage Restoration](https://gogreenrestorationtx.com/services/water-damage-restoration/)
- **Emergency**: 24/7 response available
- **Free Estimates**: Yes

**Our Water Damage Restoration Process:**

1. **Emergency Contact**: Call our 24/7 hotline. Our your area dispatch team responds immediately, gathering details about your water damage situation to prepare the right equipment and crew.
2. **Inspection & Assessment**: Our certified technicians arrive at your your area property to perform a thorough water damage inspection using moisture detection equipment to map the full extent of damage.
3. **Water Extraction**: Using commercial-grade pumps and extraction units, we remove standing water from your your area property quickly to prevent further damage to floors, walls, and belongings.
4. **Drying & Dehumidification**: We deploy industrial air movers and dehumidifiers throughout your your area home or business, monitoring moisture levels daily until the structure reaches acceptable drying standards.
5. **Cleaning & Sanitizing**: All affected areas of your your area property are cleaned, sanitized, and treated with antimicrobial solutions to prevent mold growth and eliminate odors.
6. **Restoration & Repair**: From minor drywall repairs to major reconstruction, we restore your your area property to its pre-damage condition, coordinating directly with your insurance adjuster.

### Fire & Smoke Damage Restoration

- **Page**: [Fire & Smoke Damage Restoration](https://gogreenrestorationtx.com/services/fire-smoke-damage-restoration/)
- **Emergency**: 24/7 response available
- **Free Estimates**: Yes

**Our Fire & Smoke Damage Restoration Process:**

1. **Emergency Board-Up & Tarping**: We secure your your area property immediately with professional board-up services and roof tarping to prevent further damage from weather, vandalism, or animals.
2. **Damage Assessment**: Our certified technicians perform a detailed inspection of your your area property, documenting all fire, smoke, and water damage for insurance purposes.
3. **Soot & Smoke Removal**: Using specialized equipment and techniques, we remove soot and smoke residue from all surfaces in your your area property, including walls, ceilings, and HVAC systems.
4. **Odor Elimination**: We deploy thermal fogging, ozone treatment, and hydroxyl generators to completely eliminate smoke odors from your your area home or business.
5. **Cleaning & Content Restoration**: Salvageable belongings are carefully cleaned and restored. We inventory all items and work with your insurance company on replacement of unsalvageable contents.
6. **Structural Reconstruction**: Our construction team rebuilds damaged areas of your your area property to pre-fire condition, handling all permits and inspections required by local building codes.

### Mold Remediation

- **Page**: [Mold Remediation](https://gogreenrestorationtx.com/services/mold-remediation/)
- **Emergency**: 24/7 response available
- **Free Estimates**: Yes

**Our Mold Remediation Process:**

1. **Mold Inspection & Testing**: We perform a thorough mold inspection of your your area property, including air quality testing and surface sampling to identify mold species and the extent of contamination.
2. **Containment**: Affected areas of your your area property are sealed with professional containment barriers and negative air pressure to prevent mold spores from spreading during remediation.
3. **Air Filtration**: HEPA air scrubbers and filtration systems capture airborne mold spores throughout your your area property, improving indoor air quality during the remediation process.
4. **Mold Removal**: Our technicians remove mold-infested materials and treat all affected surfaces in your your area home using EPA-registered antimicrobial solutions and eco-friendly products.
5. **Moisture Control**: We identify and address the moisture source that caused mold growth in your your area property, implementing solutions to prevent recurrence.
6. **Clearance Testing & Restoration**: Post-remediation air quality testing confirms your your area property is safe. We then restore any removed materials, including drywall, flooring, and trim.

### Sewage Backup & Cleanup

- **Page**: [Sewage Backup & Cleanup](https://gogreenrestorationtx.com/services/sewage-backup-cleanup/)
- **Emergency**: 24/7 response available
- **Free Estimates**: Yes

**Our Sewage Backup & Cleanup Process:**

1. **Emergency Response**: Our hazmat-trained crew responds to your your area property immediately, assessing the situation and implementing safety protocols to protect occupants and workers.
2. **Sewage Extraction**: Using specialized pumps and extraction equipment, we remove all sewage and contaminated water from your your area property as quickly as possible.
3. **Contaminated Material Removal**: Porous materials contaminated by sewage in your your area property — including carpet, padding, drywall, and insulation — are safely removed and disposed of according to regulations.
4. **Sanitization & Disinfection**: All surfaces in your your area property are thoroughly cleaned and disinfected with EPA-registered antimicrobial agents to eliminate bacteria, viruses, and other pathogens.
5. **Structural Drying**: Industrial dehumidifiers and air movers dry the affected areas of your your area property, with daily moisture monitoring to ensure complete drying.
6. **Restoration & Repair**: We rebuild and restore all damaged areas of your your area property, returning it to a safe, clean, pre-loss condition.
